display_name: Report a session's own context-window occupancy snapshot
description: maintenance-verbs M1 (shape (a)). Overwrites the caller's single latest context-status snapshot — agent_instance_id, the Claude Code session_id it was measured against, the model, current_tokens (input + cache_creation + cache_read from the most recent assistant turn), the resolved per-model ceiling, and when it was measured. The caller (today: the rotation_due_watch.py hook, on every un-throttled tick) already did the local transcript read and the ceiling lookup — this verb trusts the reported values and performs a plain state upsert, no file or subprocess I/O of its own. One row per agent_instance_id, always overwritten, never a history.
embedding_description: A session reporting its own current context-window token usage and ceiling so session_context_status can read it back later — a write, paired with but distinct from report_alive (liveness) and session_status (the lifecycle ledger row).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: {"status": "recorded"} on success — the caller's latest snapshot row was overwritten.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Routine and high-frequency (every un-throttled hook tick); do not narrate a normal success, only surface a failure.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A predicated upsert on session_context_status, conflicting on agent_instance_id alone (one row per session, always latest).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument: one of agent_instance_id/claude_session_id/model/measured_at was empty. negative_tokens: current_tokens or ceiling was non-positive, which cannot be a real measurement — the caller has a bug, not a transient fault. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: missing_argument and negative_tokens indicate the reporting hook computed or forwarded a bad value — fix the caller, do not retry the same call. state_service_unavailable is worth a retry once the platform is up.
